instruction: Fix windows.py: best_window(xs,k) returns the maximum sum of any contiguous window of exactly k items. Inputs are integer lists or tuples; do not modify them. k must be an integer between 1 and len(xs), otherwise raise ValueError. Handle negative values. Run `python3 test_windows.py` without modifying tests. Support arbitrary inputs and return DONE after verification. Work only inside the current directory.
